Nova X300 revenue fell 20.8% quarter over quarter in Q4 2025, primarily alongside a 16.7% unit decline; realised price fell 4.9%. Over the same period, average returns increased from 1.77% to 4.47%, including 133 quality-coded returns. Customer feedback reports recurring audio dropouts and one loose-hinge complaint, while availability remained relatively stable at 94.6% with five stockout days. Product quality is therefore the strongest supported explanation for weaker commercial performance, but the evidence establishes alignment—not causation or a confirmed root cause.
